searchText: Looks great, thanks for doing it! I understand base fee would be needed but i dont agree with it being fully burned and tips being the new fee model because thats what will happen. If theres no reason for miners to put transactions with tips no transactions without tips will get in so tips become the way they get in. I understand the burn. Base fee designs just bad though Tips *are* required, removing miner payments is not a goal of 1559. 1559 is (essentially) a load leveling mechanism that significantly improves the common-case for transaction inclusion. The 1559 Dev Fund Gitcoin Grant is live: https://gitcoin.co/grants/946/project-title-eip-1559-community-fund
